AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author

Scala 3.7.4; Mill 1.1.x; ZIO; ScalaJS; Scala Native (experimental). Paths: `build.mill`, `mill-build/src/`, `millbuild/`, `morphir/`, `morphir/foo/`, `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `contrib/`, `interop/`, `runtime/`, `testing/`, `tools/`, `src-3/`, `jvm/src-3.7/`, `test/src/`, `.config/mise/`, `project/`.

Use mise: `mise run setup`; `mise run lint`; `mise run fmt`; `mise run test:jvm`; `mise run test:js`; `mise run ci:local`.
Mill: `./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile`; `./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test`; `./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'`; `./mill morphir[3.7.4].__.jvm.test`; `./mill --no-server -j 1`; `./mill resolve __`; `./mill show <target>.sources`.

scalafmt 3.10.4, Scala 3 dialect, 120 columns. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Use `given`/`using`, `enum` where appropriate, `derives`, `extension`, `*` imports, `mvn""` (not deprecated `ivy""`); prefer ZIO lib
